basic_details.job_title: Balangir District Court Group D Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 30 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Judge, Balangir (Balangir District Court) will engage 30 persons on a daily-wage, purely temporary basis for Group-D services in the various Courts of the Judgeship of Balangir under Advertisement No. 04 of 2026. Applications in the Annexure-A format must be sent by Speed Post only to The Registrar, Civil Courts, Balangir (Patnagarh Road), P.O. / Dist. - Balangir, PIN - 767001, Odisha, and must reach the office on or before 18 November 2026 (by 5:00 P.M.). Candidates must have passed at least Class-VIII and be 18 to 42 years old.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, Annexure-A, which is printed with the notice. The form can be downloaded from the official website of District Court Balangir (balangir.dcourts.gov.in) and from the official website of the District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Balangir (balangir.odisha.gov.in). Fill all columns of the Annexure-A form carefully in your own handwriting: name in block letters, father's or husband's name, gender, marital status, date of birth, age as on 04.11.2026, permanent and present address, mobile number and e-mail ID (if any), religion, nationality, experience (if any) and the list of documents attached. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form, and sign the declaration with place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates and the documents listed under Enclosures below. Superscribe the envelope: "Application for Engagement on Daily Wage Basis" . Send the envelope by Speed Post only (not by any other mode) to: The Registrar, Civil Courts, Balangir (Patnagarh Road), P.O. / Dist. - Balangir, PIN - 767001, Odisha. The application must reach the office on or before 18 November 2026 (by 5:00 P.M.). Incomplete applications or those received after the last date and time will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 30 engagements are for Group-D services on a daily-wage, purely temporary basis. A candidate, in order to be eligible, must: Age relaxation is not specified in the notice. Candidates having proficiency in Cooking (unskilled), Driving (unskilled) and House Chores, and who may have knowledge in Electric work (unskilled) and Plumbing work (unskilled), shall be given preference, subject to overall merit. Payment will be the minimum wages of unskilled labour as fixed by the Government of Odisha from time to time as per the Government Rules/Notifications. Payment shall be made on the basis of actual attendance. No other allowances shall be admissible. The engagement is purely temporary and on daily-wage basis. It shall not confer any right for regular appointment, regularisation or absorption in service. The person engaged may be disengaged at any point of time without any prior notice. Place of posting may be at Headquarters or any outlying station of the Judgeship of Balangir, as per requirement and at the discretion of the Authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents to be submitted along with the application: Duly filled-in application form in the prescribed format Self-attested photocopy of the educational certificate(s) Self-attested photocopy of Voter ID Card / Aadhaar Card or any other Government-issued identity proof Two recent passport-size colour photographs Two self-addressed envelopes affixing postage stamp worth Rs.30/- each An undertaking that he/she shall not claim regular appointment in future An undertaking that there is no criminal case pending against him or her and that he or she has not been convicted in any case Two character certificates from any Gazetted Officers

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made through a Walk-in Interview of the eligible candidates whose applications have been received within the prescribed period and found complete in all respects. The date, time and venue of the interview will be notified later on the District Court website and on the notice boards of the District Court. Preference for cooking, driving, house chores, electric and plumbing skills applies subject to overall merit. The decision of the Authority regarding shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding, and no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid to applicants for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Balangir District Court Group-D Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 30 (Thirty) persons will be engaged on daily wage, purely temporary basis for Group-D services in the Judgeship of Balangir.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office on or before 18 November 2026, by 5:00 P.M.; late applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least Class-VIII examination conducted by any recognised educational institution, and must be able to speak, read and write Odia with elementary knowledge in English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not below 18 years and not above 42 years of age as on the date of the advertisement, 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Balangir District Court Group-D engagement?
faq.answer: Payment is the minimum wages of unskilled labour as fixed by the Government of Odisha from time to time, paid on actual attendance, with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled Annexure-A form with the listed documents by Speed Post only to The Registrar, Civil Courts, Balangir (Patnagarh Road), P.O. / Dist. - Balangir, PIN - 767001, Odisha.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed "Application for Engagement on Daily Wage Basis".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Walk-in Interview of eligible candidates whose complete applications are received in time; the date, time and venue will be notified on the District Court website and notice boards.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary on daily-wage basis, confers no right to regular appointment or absorption, and may be ended at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Candidates with proficiency in Cooking, Driving and House Chores, and knowledge of Electric and Plumbing work (all unskilled), get preference, subject to overall merit.
